unit.SPEARMAN.name: Spearman
unit.SPEARMAN.desc: Versatile foot soldier that can move, fight, build structures, and capture enemy buildings.
unit.SWORDSMAN.name: Swordsman
unit.SWORDSMAN.desc: Heavy infantry with superior combat strength. Unlocked by the Swordsman Training tech. Cleave can be researched separately.
unit.ARCHER.name: Archer
unit.ARCHER.desc: Ranged attacker that strikes from {attackRange} tiles away without stepping into melee range.
unit.CROSSBOWMAN.desc: Armor-piercing ranged attacker with {attackRange}-tile reach: ignores the target's defensive bonuses and stuns heavily-armored foes. After firing, its own DEF drops {reloadPenalty}% until its next turn.
unit.RIDER.name: Rider
unit.RIDER.desc: Swift cavalry that covers {moveRange} tiles per move to outflank and pressure the enemy.
unit.SIEGE.name: Siege
unit.SIEGE.desc: Long-range bombard with {attackRange}-tile reach; cannot fire in the same turn it moves.
unit.SCOUT.name: Scout
unit.SCOUT.desc: Light and fast explorer. Can gain special abilities through technology upgrades.
unit.GUARD.name: Guard
unit.GUARD.desc: Heavily armored defender with high defense; cannot attack in the same turn it moves.
unit.MAGE.name: Mage
unit.MAGE.desc: Arcane caster that casts spells instead of attacking, with {attackRange}-tile range and {spellsPerTurn, plural, one {# spell cast} other {# spell casts}} per turn. Recruited from active Crystal Chambers.
unit.EMBER_DEMON.name: Ember Demon
unit.SKELETON.name: Skeleton
unit.SKELETON.desc: Undead warrior raised from a gravestone.
unit.GARGOYLE.name: Gargoyle
unit.GARGOYLE.desc: Flying skeletal gargoyle raised from a Gravestone. Melee attacker that flies {moveRange} tiles over canyons and water.
unit.CROSSBOWMAN.name: Crossbowman
unit.LAVA_GRUNT.name: Lava Grunt
unit.LAVA_GRUNT.desc: Standard enemy foot soldier. Can corrupt terrain to create hostile buildings.
unit.LAVA_ARCHER.name: Lava Archer
unit.LAVA_ARCHER.desc: Enemy ranged unit that attacks from {attackRange} tiles away.
unit.LAVA_RIDER.name: Lava Rider
unit.LAVA_RIDER.desc: Enemy fast cavalry that covers {moveRange} tiles per move.
unit.LAVA_SIEGE.name: Lava Siege
unit.REAPER.name: Reaper
unit.REAPER.desc: Brutal cluster-breaker. Cleaves into adjacent enemies and grows stronger when surrounded.
unit.LANCER.name: Lancer
unit.LANCER.desc: Fast lancer that pierces through front lines, dealing full damage to units behind the target. Immune to stun.
unit.BULLWARK.name: Bullwark
unit.BULLWARK.desc: Heavily armored brute that ignores defensive bonuses and stuns heavily armored targets. Resistant to melee damage.
unit.KINDLER.name: Kindler
unit.KINDLER.desc: Ranged firestarter that scorches the target's tile.
unit.GRIMBEAK.name: Grimbeak
unit.GRIMBEAK.desc: Resilient lava beast that resists damage from summoned units, deals {summonedDamageMultiplier}× damage to them, and prioritises attacking summoned units. Grows enraged in dense clusters.
unit.RIFTWORM.name: Riftworm
unit.RIFTWORM.desc: Digs underground and re-emerges {tunnelRangeMin}–{tunnelRangeMax} tiles south in the same column, avoiding resource terrain and other Riftworms' planned exits. Digging in requires open ground (no buildings, ruins, forest or mountain). On emergence, deals {emergenceDamage} damage to all adjacent player units and corrupts the tile.
unit.RIFT_LORD.name: Rift Lord
unit.RIFT_LORD.desc: Glass-cannon caster that opens portals behind the player line, allowing enemy units to teleport into the backline.
unit.EMBERLING.name: Emberling
unit.EMBERLING.desc: Sacrificial fire spirit that seeks lava. Reaching lava destroys it and raises Ember by {emberGain}. Its EXPLODE action is available when it is blocked from reaching lava and next to player units; it deals {explosionDamage} damage to all player units within {adjacencyRange} tile and destroys itself.
unit.CAVE_MONSTER.name: Cave Monster
unit.CAVE_MONSTER.desc: A monstrous creature that emerged from deep within a mountain cave.
unit.CRYSTAL_DRAKE.name: Crystal Drake
unit.CRYSTAL_DRAKE.desc: A flying Drake summoned at a Crystal Cave. If its Crystal Cave is lost, the drake dies.
unit.CRYSTAL_KHYRON.name: Crystal Khyron
unit.CRYSTAL_KHYRON.desc: A crystalline Khyron shaped by resonance. During Crystal Chamber Resonance, its first enemy kill transforms it to the next level and permanently inherits transferable tags from that enemy. Transferable tags: Cleave, Pierce, Rage, Alert, Ironblood, Block, Puncture, Burn.
building.STRONGHOLD.name: Stronghold
building.STRONGHOLD.desc: Your capital - if you lose all your strongholds, the game is over.
building.MINE.name: Mine
building.MINE.desc: Produces {ironPerTurn} iron per turn, the primary resource for training units.
building.WOODCUTTER.name: Woodcutter
building.WOODCUTTER.desc: Produces {woodPerTurn} wood per turn, used alongside iron for buildings and recruitment.
building.BARRACKS.name: Barracks
building.BARRACKS.desc: Military hall that trains Spearman and Swordsman.
building.ARCHER_CAMP.name: Archer Camp
building.RIDER_CAMP.name: Rider Camp
building.SIEGE_CAMP.name: Siege Camp
building.SIEGE_CAMP.desc: Engineering works that trains Siege engines.
building.WATCHTOWER.name: Watchtower
building.WATCHTOWER.desc: Defensive tower that attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles and expands your vision.
building.OUTPOST.name: Outpost
building.OUTPOST.desc: Field fortification built by Spearmen via Fieldwork (costs {woodCost} wood). Attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles. Starting HP is based on the building unit's current HP, capped at {maxHp}.
building.LAVALAIR.name: Lava Lair
building.LAVALAIR.desc: Enemy spawner building. Produces Lava Grunt units.
building.INFERNALSANCTUM.name: Infernal Sanctum
building.INFERNALSANCTUM.desc: Enemy zone stronghold. Capturing it triggers a Sanctum Collapse.
building.FARM.name: Farm
building.FARM.desc: Housing for common folk - each pop raised lets you field one more basic unit.
building.PATRICIANHOUSE.name: Patrician House
building.PATRICIANHOUSE.desc: Noble estate - each noble raised lets you field one more elite unit.
building.MAGMASPYR.name: Magma Spyr
building.MAGMASPYR.desc: Corrupted mountain spire that attacks nearby units up to {maxAttacksPerTurn} times per turn.
building.EMBERNEST.name: Ember Nest
building.EMBERNEST.desc: Corrupted forest nest that spawns Emberlings every {spawnInterval, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}.
building.CRYSTAL_CHAMBER.name: Crystal Chamber
building.CRYSTAL_CHAMBER.desc: Arcane resonator. When a Crystal Chamber is consumed by lava, all surviving chambers begin resonating and generate {crystalsPerTurn, plural, one {# crystal} other {# crystals}} per turn. While active, Mages and Crystal Khyrons can be recruited once they are unlocked.
building.GRAVESTONE.name: Gravestone
building.GRAVESTONE.desc: The grave of a fallen warrior. Revive the unit by paying {reviveCrystalCost} crystal.
building.GRAVE_TRAP.name: Grave Trap
building.GRAVE_TRAP.desc: A magic trap forged from a gravestone. The next enemy to step onto it is stunned for {stunTurns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}, along with all adjacent enemies. The trap is consumed on trigger.
building.CRYSTAL_TOWER.name: Crystal Tower
building.CRYSTAL_TOWER.desc: Arcane combat tower. Attacks enemies within {attackRange} tiles. Each enemy unit it kills generates {crystalReward} crystal. Gains +{chamberAttackBonus} attack per connected Crystal Chamber within {chamberConnectRange} tiles.
building.CRYSTAL_CAVE.name: Crystal Cave
building.CRYSTAL_CAVE.desc: Conjured mountain hollow that hosts a single Crystal Drake. While resonating, it can summon a Crystal Drake. If the cave falls (lava, capture, conversion, destruction) any bound drake dies with it.
building.CHARCOAL_KILN.name: Charcoal Kiln
building.CHARCOAL_KILN.desc: Grants +{ironBonus} iron per turn per in-range kiln to each mine and deep mine within {radius} tiles.
building.DEEP_MINE.name: Deep Mine
building.DEEP_MINE.desc: Produces {ironPerTurn} iron per turn. An advanced mine that delves deeper into the mountain to extract richer ore veins.
building.MARKET.name: Market
building.MARKET.desc: A neutral market. Offers appear when the market is discovered. A unit standing here may Trade {tradesPerTurn, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} per turn for {resourceSlots, plural, one {# resource swap} other {# resource swaps}} and {specialistSlots, plural, one {# specialist offer} other {# specialist offers}}. Trading ends the unit's turn. Includes {freeRestocks, plural, one {# free restock} other {# free restocks}} every {freeRestockInterval, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}. Destroyed only by lava.
building.BRIDGE.name: Bridge
building.BRIDGE.desc: A timber bridge spanning a single canyon tile between two land tiles. Cross along its axis or diagonally; lava destroys it.
building.SCOUT_TRAP.name: Scout Trap
building.SCOUT_TRAP.desc: A concealed trap laid by a Scout. The next non-Flying enemy to enter it takes {damage} damage and is stunned for {stunTurns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}, then the trap is consumed.
resource.IRON.name: Iron
resource.WOOD.name: Wood
resource.CRYSTAL.name: Crystals
population.farmer.name: Farmers
population.noble.name: Nobles
tag.RANGED.label: Ranged
tag.RANGED.desc: Attacks from a distance and does not move onto a defeated enemy's tile.
tag.PREP.label: Prep
tag.PREP.desc: Cannot attack after moving. Must attack before moving, or forgo movement entirely.
tag.BUILDANDCAPTURE.label: Build & Capture
tag.BUILDANDCAPTURE.desc: Can construct buildings on ruins and resource terrain (forest/mountain), and capture enemy buildings. Strongholds and Watchtowers transfer to your faction; other enemy buildings are demolished.
tag.SACRIFICIAL.label: Sacrificial
tag.SACRIFICIAL.desc: Prioritizes walking toward the lava to be consumed.
tag.EXPLOSIVE.label: Explosive
tag.EXPLOSIVE.desc: Deals heavy area damage to adjacent enemies when next to an enemy (preemptive self-detonation).
tag.FIELDWORK.label: Fieldwork
tag.FIELDWORK.desc: Can sacrifice itself on its current tile to instantly erect an Outpost (costs {woodCost} wood; HP scales with the unit's current HP × {hpMultiplier}). Cannot be used on ruins or resource terrain.
tag.ASSASSIN.label: Assassin
tag.ASSASSIN.desc: Deals {damageMultiplier}× damage and receives no retaliation when striking an enemy that is still at full health.
tag.PATCHUP.label: Patch Up
tag.PATCHUP.desc: Can spend its action to restore {healAmount} HP on an adjacent friendly unit. Cannot heal Summoned or Brandmarked units.
tag.PHALANX.label: Phalanx
tag.PHALANX.desc: Grants +{defenseBonus} defense to each adjacent friendly unit and gains +{attackBonus} attack per adjacent friendly unit. Bonuses apply during combat only.
tag.CORRUPT.label: Corrupt
tag.CORRUPT.desc: Places an Ember Nest on forest tiles and a Magma Spyr on mountain tiles. Corrupts the tile.
tag.PASSIVE.label: Passive
tag.PASSIVE.desc: Cannot initiate attacks. Still defends at full effectiveness when attacked by enemies.
tag.LANCE_CHARGE.label: Lance Charge
tag.LANCE_CHARGE.desc: Gains +{attackBonus} attack when striking without having moved this turn.
tag.KNIGHT.label: Knight
tag.KNIGHT.desc: Heavily armoured cavalry with +{maxHpBonus} max HP.
tag.HIT_AND_RUN.label: Hit and Run
tag.HIT_AND_RUN.desc: Can move before and after attacking; post-attack movement is limited to {postAttackMoveRange} tile. DEF is reduced by {defensePenalty} as a trade-off for the added mobility.
tag.OUTRIDER.label: Outrider
tag.OUTRIDER.desc: +{moveBonus} movement range. Optimised for deep raids.
tag.COVER.label: Cover
tag.SKIRMISHER.label: Skirmisher
tag.PIN_DOWN.label: Pin Down
tag.PIN_DOWN.desc: Each hit has a {stunChancePct}% chance to stun the target. It cannot move or attack on its next action.
tag.DISTRACTION.label: Distraction
tag.DISTRACTION.desc: Each hit permanently reduces the target's DEF by {defenseReduction}. Archer ATK is reduced by {attackReduction}.
tag.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.label: Preventive Strike
tag.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.desc: When an enemy moves from outside into this siege unit's attack range during an enemy turn, it automatically fires, dealing {damagePercent}% of its normal attack damage. Suppressed while the siege unit stands on a Corrupted tile.
tag.ELITE.label: Elite
tag.ELITE.desc: +{maxHpBonus} max HP. Elite unit forged in the noble tradition.
tag.FORTIFIED_GARRISON.label: Fortified Garrison
tag.FORTIFIED_GARRISON.desc: Attack building gains +{attackBonus} ATK and +{rangeBonus} attack range.
tag.BLOODLUST.label: Bloodlust
tag.BLOODLUST.desc: When this Rider kills an enemy, it may make an extra attack that turn at half attack without retaliation.
tag.SPLASH.label: Splash
tag.SPLASH.desc: Deals {damagePercent}% of dealt damage to all enemy units surrounding the target.
tag.READY.label: Ready
tag.READY.desc: Can move and attack immediately after being recruited.
tag.REVIVABLE.label: Revivable
tag.REVIVABLE.desc: Leaves a Gravestone on death. Pay {reviveCrystalCost} crystal to revive.
tag.SUMMONED.label: Summoned
tag.SUMMONED.desc: Conjured by magic. Does not consume population, cannot be healed, and does not leave a gravestone on death.
tag.BRANDMARKED.label: Brandmarked
tag.BRANDMARKED.desc: +{attackBonus} ATK. Loses {hpLossPerTurn} HP at the end of every player turn. Cannot be healed by Patch Up. On death, leaves behind a hostile Ember Demon.
tag.LEASHED.label: Leashed
tag.LEASHED.desc: Summoned creature bound to a Mage. If the Mage moves beyond its attack range or dies, the leashed unit defects to the enemy.
tag.NO_GRAVESTONE.label: No Gravestone
tag.NO_GRAVESTONE.desc: Leaves no body. Cannot become a Gravestone on death.
tag.LEAVES_GRAVESTONE.label: Leaves Gravestone
tag.LAVA.label: Lava
tag.LAVA.desc: Lava-faction unit. Immune to Burning tile damage. Retained even when faction changes.
tag.CLEAVE.label: Cleave
tag.CLEAVE.desc: On hit, deals {damagePercent}% damage to all enemy units adjacent to both attacker and defender. Ignores Phalanx defense.
tag.PIERCE.label: Pierce
tag.PIERCE.desc: Deals {primaryDamagePercent}% damage to the target; the enemy unit or building directly behind the target takes {secondaryDamagePercent}% of the standard attack damage.
tag.RAGE.label: Rage
tag.RAGE.desc: Gains +{attackPerAdjacent} attack per adjacent enemy, up to {adjacentCap} enemies (maximum +{attackCap}).
tag.ALERT.label: Alert
tag.IRONBLOOD.label: Ironblood
tag.IRONBLOOD.desc: Takes only {damagePercent}% damage from attacks by Summoned units.
tag.BLOCK.label: Block
tag.BLOCK.desc: Takes only {damagePercent}% damage from melee attackers.
tag.PUNCTURE.label: Puncture
tag.PUNCTURE.desc: Ignores defensive bonuses on the target. Stuns targets with base DEF above {defenseThreshold} for {stunDuration, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}.
tag.RELOAD.label: Reload
tag.RELOAD.desc: After this unit attacks, its DEF is reduced by {defensePenaltyPct}% until the start of its next turn.
tag.BURN.label: Burn
tag.BURN.desc: Attacks set the target's tile to Burning, dealing damage to non-Lava, non-Flying, non-Cinderborn units standing there at end of turn.
tag.TUNNEL.label: Tunnel
tag.TUNNEL.desc: Digs underground and re-emerges {rangeMin}–{rangeMax} tiles south in the same column. Digging in requires open ground (no buildings, ruins, forest or mountain). Deals {emergenceDamage} damage to enemies adjacent to the emergence tile. Sets the emergence tile to Corrupted.
tag.EMBER_PORTAL.label: Ember Portal
tag.EMBER_PORTAL.desc: Casts a pair of portals: an entrance next to the Rift Lord and an exit behind the player's frontline. Any enemy unit stepping on the entrance teleports to the exit, if the exit is free. If the exit is blocked, the unit waits on the entrance and teleports the moment the exit clears. The Rift Lord cannot cast another pair until the current pair is removed. Portal tiles are Corrupted and block player movement.
tag.HOMELESS.label: Homeless
tag.HOMELESS.desc: Unit has no shelter; population cap is exceeded. -{defensePenalty} DEF. Loses {hpLossPerTurn} HP at the end of every player turn.
tag.UNTRAINED.label: Untrained
tag.UNTRAINED.desc: Training facilities of this type are over capacity. -{attackPenalty} ATK.
tag.FLYING.label: Flying
tag.FLYING.desc: Traverses canyons and unfrozen water tiles. Survives knockback over canyons and water (lava still kills). Immune to Burning tile damage. Does not ice-slide across frozen tiles. Takes +{rangedDamageTakenPct}% damage from non-Flying ranged attackers.
tag.CORRUPTED.label: Corrupted
tag.CORRUPTED.desc: Standing on a Corrupted tile. Some tag abilities are suppressed until this unit moves off the Corrupted tile.
tag.BRIDGE_BUILDER.label: Bridgebuilder
tag.BRIDGE_BUILDER.desc: Can spend its action to build a Bridge ({woodCost} wood) across a one-tile canyon gap between two land tiles. Bridge is crossable along its axis and diagonally.
tag.KNOCKBACK.label: Knockback
tag.KNOCKBACK.desc: On hit, pushes the target one tile away. Lava kills any pushed unit. Non-Flying units die if pushed into a canyon or water tile. Pushing onto a frozen tile causes an ice-slide. Units and occupied buildings block the push (no bonus damage). Flying units can still be pushed but survive canyons and water.
tag.CINDERBORN.label: Cinderborn
tag.CINDERBORN.desc: Recruited within {rows} rows of the lava front. Gains +{attackBonus} ATK and immunity to Burning tile damage.
tag.BERSERK.label: Berserk
tag.BERSERK.desc: When HP drops below {hpThresholdPct}%, gains +{attackPct}% ATK. Once triggered, stays active even if HP recovers.
tag.BATTERY.label: Battery
tag.BATTERY.desc: Gains +{attackPerAdjacent} ATK per adjacent friendly unit, up to {stackCap} stacks.
tag.RESONANCE.label: Resonance
tag.RESONANCE.desc: The first enemy this unit kills while Resonance is active transforms it to the next level and permanently inherits the killed unit's transferable tags. The transformation ends Resonance. Transferable tags: Cleave, Pierce, Rage, Alert, Ironblood, Block, Puncture, Burn. While Resonance is active, the unit recovers {healAmount} HP at the start of each turn.
tag.TAUNT.label: Taunt
tag.TAUNT.desc: Hostile units must attack this unit whenever it is a legal target within their attack range. Taunt does not force them to move toward it.
tag.STONE_SKIN.label: Stone Skin
tag.STONE_SKIN.desc: A separate pool of {stoneHp} Stone HP absorbs incoming damage before normal HP. Voluntary movement is blocked while it remains.
terrainTag.CORRUPTED.label: Corrupted
terrainTag.CORRUPTED.desc: Player units on this tile are isolated from ally tag interactions. No Phalanx bonuses, no Patch Up healing, no Pin Down / Distraction / Splash effects on attack, and no tag-based attack bonuses (Knight, Lance Charge, Assassin, Bloodlust). Preventive Strike overwatch is also suppressed. Base stats, movement, ranged capability, and persistent effects (Brandmarked) remain unchanged.
terrainTag.FROZEN.label: Frozen
terrainTag.FROZEN.desc: Units that end movement on this tile slide one additional tile in their movement direction. Sliding into water, canyon, or lava is fatal. Spawning directly onto a frozen tile triggers no slide. Flying units do not slide.
terrainTag.BURNING.label: Burning
terrainTag.BURNING.desc: Non-Lava, non-Flying, non-Cinderborn units on this tile take {damage} damage at the end of each turn.
tech.CONSCRIPTION.name: Conscription
tech.A_NOBLE_STEAD.name: A Noble Stead
tech.A_NOBLE_STEAD.desc: Attract the upper class and field swift cavalry
tech.CHARCOAL_KILN.name: Charcoal Kiln
tech.CHARCOAL_KILN.desc: Unlocks the Charcoal Kiln, which grants +{ironBonus} iron per turn per in-range kiln to nearby mines and deep mines.
tech.FAR_REACH.name: Far Reach
tech.FAR_REACH.desc: Establish archery ranges and train bowmen
tech.CROSSBOWMEN.name: Crossbowmen
tech.CROSSBOWMEN.desc: Train armor-piercing crossbowmen at your archery ranges
tech.SIEGE_WORKS.name: Siege Works
tech.SIEGE_WORKS.desc: Build Siege Camps and field devastating siege engines
tech.CLEAN_CUTS.name: Clean Cuts
tech.CLEAN_CUTS.desc: Woodcutters have a {chance}% chance to produce {amount} extra wood per turn
tech.TO_THE_FRONT.name: To the Front
tech.TO_THE_FRONT.desc: Units more than {distance} tiles behind the front gain +{moveBonus} movement range
tech.FIELD_DUTIES.name: Field Duties
tech.FIELD_DUTIES.desc: Guards can now construct and capture like builders
tech.HOLD_GROUND.name: Hold Ground
tech.HOLD_GROUND.desc: Units on own buildings gain +{defenseBonus} defense
tech.FIELDWORK.name: Fieldwork
tech.FIELDWORK.desc: Spearmen and Swordsmen can sacrifice themselves to build an Outpost ({woodCost} wood; starting HP = unit HP × {hpMultiplier})
tech.UNLOCK_SWORDSMAN.name: Swordsman Training
tech.UNLOCK_SWORDSMAN.desc: Unlocks the Swordsman - elite heavy infantry with superior attack and defense - recruitable at the Barracks. Swordsman recruitment costs +{ironCost} iron.
tech.SWORDSMAN_CLEAVE.name: Cleaving Strike
tech.SWORDSMAN_CLEAVE.desc: Swordsmen learn to cleave through enemies: on hit, they deal {damagePercent}% damage to all enemy units adjacent to both attacker and defender (ignores Phalanx defense)
tech.PHALANX_FORMATION.name: Phalanx Formation
tech.PHALANX_FORMATION.desc: Guards in formation grant +{defenseBonus} defense to each adjacent ally and gain +{attackBonus} attack per adjacent ally
tech.BIG_EYES.name: Big Eyes
tech.BIG_EYES.desc: Scouts gain +{discoverBonus} discover radius, seeing further into the fog
tech.ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
tech.ASSASSIN.desc: Scouts deal {damageMultiplier}× damage and receive no retaliation when striking a full-HP enemy
tech.PATCH_UP.name: Patch Up
tech.PATCH_UP.desc: Scouts can spend their action to restore {healAmount} HP on one adjacent friendly unit
tech.BRIDGEBUILDER.name: Bridgebuilder
tech.BRIDGEBUILDER.desc: Scouts can build a Bridge ({woodCost} wood) across a {gapTiles}-tile canyon gap between two land tiles
tech.WALLED_SETTLEMENT.name: Walled Settlement
tech.WALLED_SETTLEMENT.desc: Strongholds gain +{farmerBonus} farmer capacity. Produces +{ironAmount} iron and +{woodAmount} wood per turn (flat, once - requires at least one Stronghold)
tech.DEEP_MINING.name: Deep Mining
tech.DEEP_MINING.desc: Unlocks the Deep Mine, which produces {deepMineIron} iron per turn (vs {mineIron} for a standard Mine) - delving deeper into mountains for richer ore veins.
tech.CITADEL.name: Citadel
tech.CITADEL.desc: Grants +{nobleBonus} noble capacity to Strongholds and boosts Scout and Guard max HP by +{hpBoost}
tech.NOBLE_HERITAGE.name: Noble Heritage
tech.NOBLE_HERITAGE.desc: Grants the Elite tag to Riders, Guards, and Siege engines - each gaining +{hpBonus} max HP
tech.MASTER_RECRUITER.name: Master Recruiter
tech.LANCE_CHARGE.name: Lance Charge
tech.LANCE_CHARGE.desc: Riders gain +{attackBonus} attack when striking without having moved this turn
tech.KNIGHTS.name: Knights
tech.KNIGHTS.desc: Heavily armoured cavalry with +{maxHpBonus} max HP
tech.HIT_AND_RUN.name: Hit and Run
tech.HIT_AND_RUN.desc: Riders can make {moveCount} moves: before and after attacking (maximum {postAttackMoveRange} tile post-attack); DEF is reduced by {defensePenalty} as a trade-off
tech.OUTRIDERS.name: Outriders
tech.OUTRIDERS.desc: Fast raiding cavalry with +{moveBonus} movement range
tech.COVER.name: Cover
tech.SKIRMISHER.name: Skirmisher
tech.PIN_DOWN.name: Pin Down
tech.PIN_DOWN.desc: Archer hits have a {stunChancePct}% chance to stun the target for {stunTurns} turn - it cannot move or attack
tech.DISTRACTION.name: Distraction
tech.DISTRACTION.desc: Each archer hit permanently reduces the target's DEF by {defenseReduction}. Archers carrying this tag have their own ATK reduced by {attackReduction}
tech.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.name: Preventive Strike
tech.PREVENTIVE_STRIKE.desc: Siege engines automatically fire {shotsPerTurn} time per enemy turn at the first enemy unit that moves from outside into their attack range, dealing {damagePercent}% of their normal attack damage
tech.ARCANE_AWAKENING.name: Arcane Awakening
tech.ARCANE_AWAKENING.desc: Unlocks the Mage unit (recruited from active Crystal Chambers), the Transpose spell, and the Frostcraft spell.
tech.TAUNT.name: Taunt
tech.STONE_SKIN.name: Stone Skin
tech.EMBERBIND.name: Emberbind
tech.BRANDMARK_HEAL.name: Brandmark Heal
tech.CRYSTAL_TOWER.name: Crystal Tower
tech.CRYSTAL_TOWER.desc: Unlocks the Crystal Tower spell and Crystal Tower building.
tech.CRYSTAL_CAVE.name: Crystal Cave
tech.CRYSTAL_CAVE.desc: Unlocks the Crystal Cave spell and the Crystal Drake unit.
tech.CRYSTAL_KHYRON.name: Crystal Khyron
tech.CRYSTAL_KHYRON.desc: Unlocks the Crystal Khyron, recruitable from resonating Crystal Chambers for {crystalCost, plural, one {# Arcane Crystal} other {# Arcane Crystals}}. Crystal Khyrons transform through Resonance kills and permanently inherit transferable enemy tags.
tech.RAISE_SKELETON.name: Raise Skeleton
tech.RAISE_SKELETON.desc: Unlocks the Raise Skeleton spell and the Skeleton unit. Spearmen, Scouts, and Guards now leave Gravestones on death.
tech.GRAVE_TRAP.name: Grave Trap
tech.GRAVE_HARVEST.name: Grave Harvest
tech.GRAVE_HARVEST.desc: Each player-owned Gravestone has a {chancePercent}% chance per turn to grant {crystalAmount} arcane crystal.
tech.GRAVE_WARRIORS.name: Grave Warriors
tech.GRAVE_WARRIORS.desc: Riders, Swordsmen, Archers, and Crossbowmen now leave Gravestones on death.
tech.GRAVE_ENGINES.name: Grave Engines
tech.GRAVE_ENGINES.desc: Siege engines and Mages now leave Gravestones on death.
tech.EXPLODE.name: Explode
tech.SPELL_REACH.name: Spell Reach
tech.SPELL_REACH.desc: Increases the Mage's attack range by +{rangeBonus} (to {totalRange} tiles).
spell.TRANSPOSE.name: Transpose
spell.TRANSPOSE.desc: Swap the positions of two units of the same faction within range of the Mage.
spell.TRANSPOSE.targetHint: Select the first unit to swap.
spell.TRANSPOSE.targetHintSecondPick: Select the second unit (same faction as the first).
spell.EMBERBIND.name: Emberbind
spell.EMBERBIND.desc: Target an Ember Nest within range. The nest is destroyed (forest restored) and a friendly Ember Demon appears, leashed within the Mage's attack range.
spell.EMBERBIND.targetHint: Select an Ember Nest within range.
spell.BRANDMARK_HEAL.name: Brandmark Heal
spell.BRANDMARK_HEAL.desc: Fully heal one player unit, multiply its max HP by {hpMultiplier}×, grant +{attackBonus} ATK, and mark it with the brand. The marked unit loses {hpLoss} HP at the end of each turn and cannot be healed by Patch Up. On death, a hostile Ember Demon rises in its place.
spell.BRANDMARK_HEAL.targetHint: Select one of your own units within range (not another Mage).
spell.RAISE_SKELETON.name: Raise Skeleton
spell.RAISE_SKELETON.desc: Target a Gravestone within range to raise a Skeleton. The gravestone is consumed.
spell.RAISE_SKELETON.targetHint: Select a player Gravestone within range.
spell.FROSTCRAFT.name: Frostcraft
spell.FROSTCRAFT.desc: Freeze a Water tile within range. Player units may walk on the ice; enemies cannot. The ice persists until consumed by lava.
spell.FROSTCRAFT.targetHint: Select a water tile within range.
spell.GRAVE_TRAP.name: Grave Trap
spell.GRAVE_TRAP.desc: Convert an empty Gravestone within range into a magical trap. The next enemy unit to step onto it is stunned for {stunTurns} turns, and all enemies within {adjacencyRange} tile are stunned as well.
spell.GRAVE_TRAP.targetHint: Select a player Gravestone within range.
spell.EXPLODE.name: Explode
spell.EXPLODE.desc: Sacrifice a player unit within range. It deals {damagePercent}% of its current HP to each adjacent enemy. The unit is fully consumed - no gravestone is left.
spell.EXPLODE.targetHint: Select one of your own units within range to sacrifice.
spell.CRYSTAL_TOWER.name: Crystal Tower
spell.CRYSTAL_TOWER.desc: Sacrifice the Mage to erect a permanent Crystal Tower on its tile. Each enemy unit the tower kills generates {crystalReward} crystal.
spell.CRYSTAL_TOWER.targetHint: The Mage will be consumed where it stands. Confirm by selecting the Mage's tile.
spell.CRYSTAL_CAVE.name: Crystal Cave
spell.CRYSTAL_CAVE.desc: Conjure a Crystal Cave on a free mountain tile within range. While any of your Crystal Chambers resonate, the cave may recruit a single Crystal Drake - recruiting does not shorten the resonance window. If the cave is lost (lava, capture, conversion, destruction) the drake dies with it.
spell.CRYSTAL_CAVE.targetHint: Select a free mountain tile within range.
spell.RUPTURE.name: Rupture
spell.RUPTURE.desc: Deal {damagePercent}% of the target's current HP as damage (never kills - target retains at least {minimumHp} HP). Costs {crystalCost} crystal. Unlocked by the Sundered specialist.
spell.RUPTURE.targetHint: Select an enemy unit within range.
spell.TAUNT.name: Taunt
spell.TAUNT.desc: Mark a friendly unit. Hostile units must attack it whenever it is a legal target within their attack range.
spell.TAUNT.targetHint: Select a player unit within range to taunt.
spell.STONE_SKIN.name: Stone Skin
spell.STONE_SKIN.desc: Grant a friendly unit {stoneHp} Stone HP. Incoming damage is absorbed by Stone HP before normal HP.
spell.STONE_SKIN.targetHint: Select a player unit within range to grant Stone Skin.
specialist.spec_01.name: Garrison Commander
specialist.spec_01.desc: All your Watchtowers, Outposts, and Crystal Towers gain +{attackBonus} attack and +{rangeBonus} attack range.
specialist.spec_02.name: Bloodrider
specialist.spec_02.desc: When one of your Riders kills an enemy, it may attack once more this turn at half attack and without retaliation.
specialist.spec_03.name: Siege Tactician
specialist.spec_03.desc: Your Siege units deal {damagePercent}% of their damage to all enemy units surrounding their target.
specialist.spec_04.name: Drill Sergeant
specialist.spec_04.desc: Your Spearman and Swordsman units can move and attack immediately after being recruited.
specialist.spec_05.name: Deathmender
specialist.spec_05.desc: When one of your Spearmen, Scouts, or Guards dies, a Gravestone is left on their tile. Pay {crystalCost} crystal to raise a flying Gargoyle from any Gravestone.
specialist.spec_06.name: Archmage
specialist.spec_06.desc: Your Mages can cast {casts} spells per turn instead of {baseCasts}.
specialist.spec_07.name: Ashwright
specialist.spec_07.desc: Your Charcoal Kilns affect mines and deep mines within {range} tiles instead of {baseRange}.
specialist.spec_08.name: Trapsmith
specialist.spec_08.desc: Your Scouts can place a Scout Trap within {range} {range, plural, one {tile} other {tiles}} of their position (costs {woodCost} wood). The next non-Flying enemy to enter it takes {damage} damage and is stunned for {stunTurns} {stunTurns, plural, one {turn} other {turns}}.
specialist.spec_09.name: Watch Captain
specialist.spec_09.desc: Your garrisoned Watchtowers, Outposts, and Crystal Towers fire a preventive shot at {damagePercent}% damage when an enemy enters their range.
specialist.spec_10.name: Cinder Warden
specialist.spec_10.desc: Your Scouts can extinguish Burning and Corrupted tiles within {radius} {radius, plural, one {tile} other {tiles}}, consuming their action.
specialist.spec_11.name: Farsight Marshal
specialist.spec_11.desc: Your Scouts gain +{rangeBonus} attack range and become ranged.
specialist.spec_12.name: Tramplelord
specialist.spec_12.desc: Your Riders push enemies {knockbackRange} tile away on every hit (Knockback).
specialist.spec_13.name: Hellbinder
specialist.spec_13.desc: All your Summoned units gain the Rage and Cleave tags.
specialist.spec_14.name: Hearthsteward
specialist.spec_14.desc: Each of your Farms can house {capacityBonus} extra farmer.
specialist.spec_15.name: Forgemaster
specialist.spec_15.desc: Units recruited within {rows} rows of the lava front gain the Cinderborn tag (+{attackBonus} ATK and immunity to Burning tile damage).
specialist.spec_16.name: The Martyr
specialist.spec_16.desc: When one of your units is consumed by lava, all surviving Crystal Chambers begin resonating as if a chamber were destroyed.
specialist.spec_17.name: Bombardier
specialist.spec_17.desc: Your Siege units gain the Battery tag: each adjacent friendly unit grants +{attackPerAdjacent} ATK, up to {stackCap} stacks.
specialist.spec_18.name: Echo Warden
specialist.spec_18.desc: While resonating, each Crystal Chamber within {rows} rows of the lava front generates +{crystalBonus} extra crystal per turn.
specialist.spec_19.name: Wallbreaker
specialist.spec_19.desc: Your Archers deal {damagePercent}% bonus damage when attacking buildings.
specialist.spec_20.name: Deathsworn
specialist.spec_20.desc: Your Archers gain the Berserk tag: when HP drops below {hpThresholdPct}%, they gain +{attackPct}% ATK. Once triggered, it stays active even if HP recovers.
specialist.spec_21.name: Pathfinder
specialist.spec_21.desc: Capturing an enemy Stronghold immediately reveals the full zone it belongs to.
specialist.spec_22.name: The Sundered
specialist.spec_22.desc: Your Mages unlock the Rupture spell: deals {damagePercent}% of the target's current HP as damage for {crystalCost} crystal.
specialist.spec_23.name: The Matriarch
specialist.spec_23.desc: Doubles farmer and noble housing caps and recruitment unit limits. New units have their iron and wood recruitment cost and max HP halved, rounded up.
specialist.spec_24.name: Field Chirurgeon
specialist.spec_24.desc: Player units that took no action this turn are healed for {healAmount} HP at the end of the player turn.
specialist.spec_25.name: Estate Warden
specialist.spec_25.desc: Each Patrician House houses {capacityBonus} extra noble.
specialist.spec_26.name: Quartermaster
specialist.spec_26.desc: 🎖️ Each recruitment building supports {capacityBonus} additional unit. Crystal Caves and Crystal Chambers are not affected.
hint.H01_BUILD_WOODCUTTER.short: Move a unit onto a forest tile to build a Woodcutter for wood income.
hint.H01_BUILD_WOODCUTTER.detail: Most of your units can construct buildings. Select a unit, move it onto a forest tile, then choose Build. Wood is needed for buildings and many units.
hint.H01B_RECRUIT_GUARD.short: Recruit a Guard in your Stronghold to help construct and expand.
hint.H01B_RECRUIT_GUARD.detail: Open your Stronghold and recruit a Guard. Guards are cheap, sturdy units, and after researching Field Duties they can also build and capture to support your early expansion.
hint.H02_BUILD_MINE.short: Now move a unit onto a mountain tile to build a Mine for iron.
hint.H02_BUILD_MINE.detail: Iron pays for military units and buildings. Mountains without a cave entrance can hold a Mine. Keep expanding your economy while the lava is still far away.
hint.H03_BUILD_ON_RUIN.short: Ruins are free building slots. Move a unit onto a ruin to construct.
hint.H03_BUILD_ON_RUIN.detail: Scattered ruins are the only places where you can put up new structures like Farms, Barracks or Crystal Chambers. Forests and mountains only hold resource buildings. Claim ruins early, they are limited.
hint.H04_RUIN_MENU_FIRST.short: Farm grows farmer population. Barracks recruits Spearmen.
hint.H04_RUIN_MENU_FIRST.detail: A Farm houses farmers, the population most units need for recruitment. A Barracks lets you recruit Spearmen and, later, Swordsmen. A solid start: one Farm, one Barracks.
hint.H05_ATTACK_ENDS_TURN.short: Attacking ends a unit's turn. It cannot move afterwards.
hint.H05_ATTACK_ENDS_TURN.detail: Move first, then attack. Once a unit attacks, both its move and its action are spent for this turn. Plan positioning before committing to a fight, melee attackers also take retaliation damage.
hint.H06_LAVA_ADVANCE.short: The lava advances! It devours tiles, buildings and units from the south.
hint.H06_LAVA_ADVANCE.detail: Every few turns the lava front moves one row north, consuming everything on it. The counter in the HUD shows turns until the next advance. You cannot stop it, keep moving north and let go of what lies behind.
hint.H07_RECRUIT_NO_RESOURCES.short: Not enough resources for this unit.
hint.H07_RECRUIT_NO_RESOURCES.detail: Each unit costs iron, wood or crystals. Expand Mines and Woodcutters to afford stronger units, or trade at a Market if you find one.
hint.H08_RECRUIT_NO_POPULATION.short: Not enough population to recruit this unit.
hint.H08_RECRUIT_NO_POPULATION.detail: Units are recruited from your population: farmers live in Farms, nobles in Patrician Houses. Housing fills up over time. Build more housing, or wait for population to grow.
hint.H09_RECRUIT_NO_CAPACITY.short: This building type is at its recruitment capacity.
hint.H09_RECRUIT_NO_CAPACITY.detail: Each building type supports a limited number of active units. Build another building of this type to raise the cap. Units above the cap become Untrained and fight worse.
hint.H10_HOMELESS.short: A unit is homeless! It loses HP every turn.
hint.H10_HOMELESS.detail: Your population exceeds housing capacity, the most recently recruited units lose their shelter: -{defensePenalty} DEF and {hpLoss} HP at the end of every player turn. Build more Farms or Patrician Houses, or the unit will wither away.
hint.H11_UNTRAINED.short: A unit is untrained! It fights with reduced attack.
hint.H11_UNTRAINED.detail: You have more units of this kind than your training buildings support. Untrained units suffer -{attackPenalty} ATK. Build another Barracks, camp or chamber of the matching type to restore full strength.
hint.H12_CORRUPTION.short: This unit stands on corrupted ground. Its abilities are suppressed.
hint.H12_CORRUPTION.detail: Corruption is dead, poisoned terrain claimed by the enemy. Units standing on it lose the benefit of certain ability tags. Move off corrupted tiles, or research means to cleanse them (Scouts can extinguish corruption with the right tech).
hint.H13_BURNING.short: Burning ground! Units standing on it take damage.
hint.H13_BURNING.detail: Burning tiles deal {damage} damage to non-Lava, non-Flying, non-Cinderborn units at the end of the turn. Move out of the fire. Lava, Flying, and Cinderborn units are immune.
hint.H14_FIRST_TECH_FIELD_DUTIES.short: Good first research: Field Duties. Guards learn to build and capture.
hint.H14_FIRST_TECH_FIELD_DUTIES.detail: Guards are cheap and sturdy but cannot construct or capture until you research Field Duties. With it, Guards become your workhorses: they build, they capture, they hold the line. Research gets more expensive as the Ember Level rises, so research early.
hint.H15_CHAMBER_RESONANCE.short: Crystal Chambers awaken when the lava devours one of them.
hint.H15_CHAMBER_RESONANCE.detail: When the lava consumes a Crystal Chamber, you gain crystals and all surviving chambers resonate for {duration} turns, producing {crystalsPerTurn} crystal per turn each. Build chambers in the lava's path on purpose and chain the sacrifice. Resonating chambers can also recruit Mages and Crystal Khyrons once unlocked.
hint.H16_CHAMBER_NOT_RESONATING.short: This chamber is dormant. Mages and Crystal Khyrons can only be recruited while it resonates.
hint.H16_CHAMBER_NOT_RESONATING.detail: A chamber resonates for a few turns after any of your chambers is devoured by lava. Only a resonating chamber can recruit a Mage (requires Arcane Awakening) or a Crystal Khyron (requires the Crystal Khyron tech). Sacrifice a chamber to the lava to wake the others.
hint.H17_CAVE_NOT_RESONATING.short: This cave is dormant. The Crystal Drake needs resonance to be recruited.
hint.H17_CAVE_NOT_RESONATING.detail: Crystal Caves follow the same rule as chambers: only while your chambers resonate can the cave recruit its Crystal Drake. The drake dies if the cave is lost.
hint.H18_EMBER_LEVEL.short: The Ember Level rose. Stronger enemies unlock and research gets pricier.
hint.H18_EMBER_LEVEL.detail: The Ember Level is the world's threat scale. It rises over time and through enemy rituals. Higher ember unlocks stronger enemy units and increases every research cost (base cost + ember). Tap the ember display for a breakdown of its sources.
hint.H19_EMBERBIND_LEASH.short: The Ember Demon is leashed to your Mage. Keep them close!
hint.H19_EMBERBIND_LEASH.detail: The bound Ember Demon stays loyal only while it remains within the Mage's leash range. If the Mage moves too far away (checked at end of turn, and during the enemy turn), the demon defects and turns hostile. Move the Mage carefully.
hint.H20_BUILD_NO_RESOURCES.short: Not enough resources to construct this building.
hint.H20_BUILD_NO_RESOURCES.detail: Each building costs iron and wood, shown on its button. Expand Woodcutters for wood and Mines for iron, and check the per-turn income badges in the top bar.
